messages:
ana: Noticed a console alert: structured-validation.failures spiked for routeId=partner-integration. Errors mostly show "enum_mismatch" on field "action_type". Anyone know which customer or SDK version?

ben: I grabbed a sample. Payload from adapter: 
```json
{"action_type":"Open-FILE","file":{"path":"/tmp/secrets"}}
```
Our schema expects action_type in lowercase snake_case enum: ["open_file", "close_file", "read_file"] so the validator marks it as invalid (soft), then the router falls back to permissive model.

ravi: This came up immediately after we flipped the strict-schema-canary for the function hook. Canary config: strict=true, sample_rate=0.1. But the spikes are ~1% of traffic not 0.1% so sampling mismatch somewhere.

observability-bot: alert: structured-validation.failures > 0.02 for routeId=partner-integration (us-east) — triggered at 2026-03-22T09:10:00Z :warning:

emma: The console dashboard aggregates tagged streams (canary vs prod) but our tag enrichment pipeline drops the canary tag for requests forwarded by the edge proxy v2.1. So 10% of canary events look like prod and inflate counts. Filed infra ticket INF-312.

ana (typo): oops meant ana: We also have a secondary issue: sampled payloads on the panel show full bodies. Partner payloads can include PII. We need redaction before surfacing in the console. Can we switch to redacted samples by default?

ben: Agreed. We have a small privacy-aware sampler we used for embeddings. Idea: introduce sample_kv with metadata-only view and an admin-only raw link. Microcopy: "Sampled payload (redacted). Click to reveal raw — requires audit role."

ravi: Back to billing/metrics: current code increments "fncall.validation.rejections" for both soft and hard. That bubbled into the SLA dashboard and caused an automated alert to CS. We discussed before: soft failures that auto-fallback should not count against SLA or quota. Implementation mismatch again.

emma: Quick patch plan: emit two metrics — fncall.validation.soft_failures and fncall.validation.hard_failures. SLA/alerting rules should reference hard_failures only. Also set a transitional mapping for historical dashboards.

observability-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/patch/strict-schema-metrics -> us-east at 2026-03-22T09:22:10Z (ravi) :rocket:

product-analyst: For the console UI, can we display both series stacked and include a legend note? Customers will ask what "soft" means. Suggest tooltip: "Soft validation = automatic fallback to permissive model; not billed, visible for debugging unless redaction enabled."

ana (typo): ana: For privacy redaction: propose default redaction rules (PII: emails, paths, tokens). But partner payloads often include developer test paths. We should make redaction configurable per-org.

ben: Implementation detail: sampler currently records event_id + gzipped payload. Plugin to run redaction before storage — should be cheap. Will open PR. Also we need to add an audit log entry when raw view is requested.

ravi: After metric patch, run an offline recompute job to recalculate SLA windows for the last 72h to avoid false CS alerts. Kyle/ops might want to be looped in.

observability-bot: deploy success: eng-platform/patch/strict-schema-metrics -> us-east at 2026-03-22T09:27:55Z (ravi) :tada:

emma: Dashboard changes: added stacked soft/hard series, legend, and a toggle for raw vs redacted samples (admin-only). Left a comment on the panel with links to INF-312 and the PR.

ana (typo): ana: PR looks good. Also added unit tests for enum coercion (case-insensitive) as an opt-in transformer. We shouldn't retroactively coerce by default, but provide adapter helpers for partners.

ben: Rolling canary of redaction + sample-ui to 5% now. Will monitor for sampling tag retention (INF-312 fix in progress).

product-analyst: Also added a note in the release changelog about billing semantics and sample visibility to avoid surprise escalations.

ana (typo): ana: Ok team — can we capture follow-ups: 1) infra retains canary tag (INF-312) 2) backfill SLA recalculation (ravi) 3) redaction + admin-raw-view (ben) 4) adapter helper for case-insensitive enum coercion (ben/partners). If no regressions in 2h, promote changes.

observability-bot: scheduled check-in in 2h for routeId=partner-integration.

ravi: Noted. I'll coordinate with ops for the backfill window.

ana (typo): ana: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop unless the partner files a support ticket.
